responsibility: This file implements WPA/LTRANS partition construction and partition-boundary symbol handling for WHOPR-style LTO. It owns the ltrans_partitions vector and the logic that groups symtab and cgraph nodes into ltrans_partition encoders, pulls in required references, inline clones, aliases, and constant-initializer dependencies, computes per-partition size/symbol counts for mapping strategies, and then fixes cross-partition linkage by promoting or renaming statics and validating target-visible aliases; it is the module that turns a merged whole-program symbol graph into safe, streamable LTRANS work units.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the lto-partition pair: it builds and manipulates LTRANS partitions, computes partition boundaries, and promotes or renames cross-partition statics, whereas gcc/lto/lto-partition.h only defines the partition data structure and declares the partitioning APIs.
